name: clangd-cannot-load
description: 0.0.3 plan B1: a clangd that cannot run on this machine at all -- what the official arm64 build is on a system whose libstdc++ is too old. Its `prepare` step puts a stand-in clangd in the workspace that writes the loader's message (a GLIBCXX version not found) to standard error and exits 1, and `--clangd` points the server at it. The server used to wait on clangd's handshake for good, so an editor never got past initialize; now initialize is answered at once, clangd is not restarted, the status is error with issue engine-incompatible, and mcppls's own module features work.
